title: About
description: About the artist, and where to find their work.

text: So this is the about page for my website. It explains what this is and why it exists.

This is a curated visual art stream that I created. It displays an ongoing series of relevant work and offers select pieces for sale in a variety of media. It is not a complete representation of my work and is a separate project.

So many great things, not just art, have emerged out of failure of one kind or another. One could argue that failure is intrinsic to “progress” of any sort. I find this fascinating as my work strongly embodies this tension by default.
Rather than provide a series of boring explanations which would only serve to diminish the work, here are a few important questions to consider:
